today.title: Today
today.emptyBody: Create a space and add your first note. Cards you make from your notes will show up here when they are due.

status.degraded: The server is running, but the database is not responding

errors.payloadTooLarge: The note is too large (limit 2 MB).
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the server.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has ended. Sign in again.

auth.title: Sign in to your Hub
auth.body: Open the one-time link printed in the terminal where the Hub started. Need a new link? Run one of these commands:
auth.invalid: This link is invalid, expired or already used.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try a new link.
auth.error: Sign-in failed. Try a new link.

spaces.title: Spaces
spaces.intro: A space holds one area you are learning, such as a Holberton project or a track.
spaces.empty: No spaces yet. Create your first one above.

topics.title: Topics
topics.intro: Break the space into concepts you want to be able to explain without help.

notes.exists: A note with this path already exists.
notes.collision: Another note differs only in letter case or accents. Choose a different name.
notes.invalidPath: This file name or folder is not allowed.
notes.conflict: This note changed on disk since you opened it.
notes.readOnly: Hub cannot safely edit this file (unsupported encoding or mixed line endings).

notesPage.title: Notes
notesPage.intro: Your Markdown notes. They stay plain .md files you can open in Obsidian or any editor.
notesPage.empty: No notes yet. Create one above or put .md files in your vault folder.

editor.label: Edit {title}
editor.hint: Ctrl+S / ⌘S saves. Links like [[Note]] and #tags are picked up automatically.
editor.conflict: This note was changed outside the Hub (for example in Obsidian) after you opened it.
